in_marathi.name: Shaambhavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Speech
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaambhavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shaambhavi is the Goddess of Speech and Learning. She is also known as Saraswati's shakti and is considered the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
